d: Long, flowing ash-brown hair with straight bangs and a side parting, paired with almond-shaped, shimmering golden-brown eyes and red-rimmed glasses. The face is that of a mature teenager with a slender build. The outfit is a school uniform consisting of a beige button-up shirt, a navy blue sailor-style collar with a large pink bow, a short pleated navy blue skirt, grey knee-high socks, and brown loafers. Accessories include a dark grey ribbon in the hair, a small pink and blue crossbody bag adorned with charms, a handheld smartphone, and a floating metallic spherical drone with a glowing cyan core.
